items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to the definition of the term final average salary as applied to members of the New York city teachers' retirement system
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5748

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to
the definition of the term final average salary as applied to members
of the New York city teachers' retirement system


 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
This legislation amends sections 443,512 and 608 of the retirement and
social security law, to provide include members of the New York City
Teachers' Retirement System within existing provisions governing the
calculation of final average salary.

 JUSTIFICATION :
This legislation is designed and intended to correct a technical
omission affecting the calculation of final average salary for certain
members in the New York City Teachers' Retirement System.
Specifically, this legislation would provide statutory clarification
that final average salary would constitute the three highest
consecutive years of a member's compensation, as opposed to a member's
total compensation in the three consecutive years prior to retirement.
This definitional differentiation is critical to a member who takes a
leave of absence of less than or equal to 12 months at no or partial
pay in the three-year period predating such member's retirement. This
legislation clarifies current statute in order to provide affected
members with the same benefits currently afforded under administrative
rule and practice.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
If this proposed legislation is enacted during the current Legislative
Session before June 30, 2009, there would be no increase in employer
contributions to NYCTRS for Fiscal Year 2009.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
